===== examples/tauri-app/README.md =====
# Svelte + Vite

This template should help get you started developing with Tauri and Svelte in Vite.

## Recommended IDE Setup

[VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) + [Svelte](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=svelte.svelte-vscode) + [Tauri](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=tauri-apps.tauri-vscode) + [rust-analyzer](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=rust-lang.rust-analyzer).


===== examples/tauri-app/src/App.svelte =====
<script>
  import Greet from './lib/Greet.svelte'
  import { ping } from 'tauri-plugin-alarm-api'

	let response = $state('')

	function updateResponse(returnValue) {
		response += `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ` + (typeof returnValue === 'string' ? returnValue : JSON.stringify(returnValue)) + '<br>'
	}

	function _ping() {
		ping("Pong!").then(updateResponse).catch(updateResponse)
	}
</script>

<main class="container">
  <h1>Welcome to Tauri!</h1>

  <div class="row">
    <a href="https://vite.dev" target="_blank">
      <img src="/vite.svg" class="logo vite" alt="Vite Logo" />
    </a>
    <a href="https://tauri.app" target="_blank">
      <img src="/tauri.svg" class="logo tauri" alt="Tauri Logo" />
    </a>
    <a href="https://svelte.dev" target="_blank">
      <img src="/svelte.svg" class="logo svelte" alt="Svelte Logo" />
    </a>
  </div>

  <p>
    Click on the Tauri, Vite, and Svelte logos to learn more.
  </p>

  <div class="row">
    <Greet />
  </div>

  <div>
    <button onclick="{_ping}">Ping</button>
    <div>{@html response}</div>
  </div>

</main>

===== examples/tauri-app/src/lib/Greet.svelte =====
<script>
  import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core"

  let name = $state("");
  let greetMsg = $state("")

  async function greet(){
    // Learn more about Tauri commands at https://v2.tauri.app/develop/calling-rust/#commands
    greetMsg = await invoke("greet", { name })
  }
</script>

<div>
  <div class="row">
    <input id="greet-input" placeholder="Enter a name..." bind:value={name} />
    <button onclick={greet}>
      Greet
    </button>
  </div>
  <p>{greetMsg}</p>
</div>

===== examples/tauri-app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs =====
// Learn more about Tauri commands at https://v2.tauri.app/develop/calling-rust/#commands
#[tauri::command]
fn greet(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("Hello, {}! You've been greeted from Rust!", name)
}

#[cfg_attr(mobile, tauri::mobile_entry_point)]
pub fn run() {
    tauri::Builder::default()
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![greet])
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_alarm::init())
        .run(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while running tauri application");
}

===== examples/tauri-app/vite.config.js =====
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import { svelte } from "@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte";

const host = process.env.TAURI_DEV_HOST;

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [svelte()],

  // Vite options tailored for Tauri development and only applied in `tauri dev` or `tauri build`
  // prevent Vite from obscuring rust errors
  clearScreen: false,
  // tauri expects a fixed port, fail if that port is not available
  server: {
    host: host || false,
    port: 1420,
    strictPort: true,
    hmr: host ? {
      protocol: 'ws',
      host,
      port: 1421
    } : undefined,
    watch: {
      ignored: ['**/src-tauri/**']
    },
  },
})

===== guest-js/index.ts =====
import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core';

export interface AlarmArgs {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  stepName?: string;
  foodName?: string;
  dismissLabel?: string;
}

export interface PermissionStatus {
  notificationsGranted: boolean;
  exactAlarmGranted: boolean;
  fullScreenIntentGranted: boolean;
}

export interface RingingStatus {
  ringing: boolean;
}

export async function ring(args: AlarmArgs): Promise<void> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|ring', { args });
}

export async function dismiss(): Promise<void> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|dismiss');
}

export async function isAlarmRinging(): Promise<RingingStatus> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|is_alarm_ringing');
}

export async function checkAndroidPermissions(): Promise<PermissionStatus> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|check_android_permissions');
}

export async function requestNotificationPermission(): Promise<void> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|request_notification_permission');
}

export async function openExactAlarmSettings(): Promise<void> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|open_exact_alarm_settings');
}

export async function openFullScreenIntentSettings(): Promise<void> {
  return invoke('plugin:alarm|open_full_screen_intent_settings');
}

  input: 'guest-js/index.ts',

    {
      file: pkg.exports.import,

      format: 'cjs'

}

use tauri::{plugin::PluginApi, AppHandle, Runtime};

use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::models::{AlarmArgs, RingingStatus};

pub struct Alarm<R: Runtime> {
    _app: AppHandle<R>,
}

impl<R: Runtime> Alarm<R> {
    pub fn new(app: &AppHandle<R>, _api: PluginApi<R, ()>) -> Result<Self> {
        Ok(Self { _app: app.clone() })
    }

    pub fn ring(&self, _args: AlarmArgs) -> Result<()> {
        Err(Error::UnsupportedPlatform)
    }

    pub fn dismiss(&self) -> Result<()> {
        Err(Error::UnsupportedPlatform)
    }

    pub fn is_alarm_ringing(&self) -> Result<RingingStatus> {
        Ok(RingingStatus { ringing: false })
    }

    pub fn open_exact_alarm_settings(&self) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn open_full_screen_intent_settings(&self) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }
}

===== src/error.rs =====
use serde::{Serialize, Serializer};
use std::fmt;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Error {
    Invoke(String),
    Tauri(tauri::Error),
    UnsupportedPlatform,
}

impl fmt::Display for Error {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Error::Invoke(s) => write!(f, "invoke: {s}"),
            Error::Tauri(e) => write!(f, "tauri: {e}"),
            Error::UnsupportedPlatform => write!(f, "not supported on this platform"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for Error {}

impl From<tauri::Error> for Error {
    fn from(e: tauri::Error) -> Self {
        Error::Tauri(e)
    }
}

impl Serialize for Error {
    fn serialize<S: Serializer>(&self, s: S) -> std::result::Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
        s.serialize_str(&self.to_string())
    }
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

===== src/lib.rs =====
use tauri::{
    plugin::{Builder, TauriPlugin},
    AppHandle, Manager, Runtime, Wry,
};

mod desktop;
mod error;
mod mobile;
mod models;

pub use error::{Error, Result};
pub use models::{AlarmArgs, RingingStatus};

#[cfg(desktop)]
pub use desktop::Alarm;
#[cfg(mobile)]
pub use mobile::Alarm;

pub trait AlarmExt<R: Runtime> {
    fn alarm(&self) -> &Alarm<R>;
}

impl<R: Runtime, T: Manager<R>> AlarmExt<R> for T {
    fn alarm(&self) -> &Alarm<R> {
        self.state::<Alarm<R>>().inner()
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn ring(app: AppHandle, args: AlarmArgs) -> Result<()> {
    app.alarm().ring(args)
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn dismiss(app: AppHandle) -> Result<()> {
    app.alarm().dismiss()
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn is_alarm_ringing(app: AppHandle) -> Result<RingingStatus> {
    app.alarm().is_alarm_ringing()
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn open_exact_alarm_settings(app: AppHandle) -> Result<()> {
    app.alarm().open_exact_alarm_settings()
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn open_full_screen_intent_settings(app: AppHandle) -> Result<()> {
    app.alarm().open_full_screen_intent_settings()
}

pub fn init() -> TauriPlugin<Wry> {
    Builder::<Wry>::new("alarm")
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            ring,
            dismiss,
            is_alarm_ringing,
            open_exact_alarm_settings,
            open_full_screen_intent_settings,
        ])
        .setup(|app, api| {
            let alarm = Alarm::new(app, api)?;
            app.manage(alarm);
            Ok(())
        })
        .build()
}

===== src/mobile.rs =====
use serde::Serialize;
use tauri::{
    plugin::{PluginApi, PluginHandle},
    AppHandle, Runtime,
};

use crate::error::{Error, Result};
use crate::models::{AlarmArgs, RingingStatus};

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct EmptyArgs {}

pub struct Alarm<R: Runtime> {
    handle: PluginHandle<R>,
}

impl<R: Runtime> Alarm<R> {
    pub fn new(_app: &AppHandle<R>, api: PluginApi<R, ()>) -> Result<Self> {
        let handle = api
            .register_android_plugin("com.cookplans.alarm", "AlarmPlugin")
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(format!("{e:?}")))?;
        Ok(Self { handle })
    }

    pub fn ring(&self, args: AlarmArgs) -> Result<()> {
        self.handle
            .run_mobile_plugin::<()>("ring", args)
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn dismiss(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.handle
            .run_mobile_plugin::<()>("dismiss", EmptyArgs {})
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn is_alarm_ringing(&self) -> Result<RingingStatus> {
        self.handle
            .run_mobile_plugin::<RingingStatus>("isAlarmRinging", EmptyArgs {})
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn open_exact_alarm_settings(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.handle
            .run_mobile_plugin::<()>("openExactAlarmSettings", EmptyArgs {})
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn open_full_screen_intent_settings(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.handle
            .run_mobile_plugin::<()>("openFullScreenIntentSettings", EmptyArgs {})
            .map_err(|e| Error::Invoke(e.to_string()))
    }
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct AlarmArgs {
    pub title: String,
    pub body: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub step_name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub food_name: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_dismiss_label")]
    pub dismiss_label: String,
}

fn default_dismiss_label() -> String {
    "Dismiss".to_string()
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct RingingStatus {
    pub ringing: bool,
}

    architecture: Architecture::X86_64,
    vendor: Vendor::Unknown,
    operating_system: OperatingSystem::Linux,
    environment: Environment::Gnu,
    binary_format: BinaryFormat::Elf,
};

    /// Return the architecture for the current host.

        Architecture::X86_64
    }
}

    /// Return the vendor for the current host.
    pub const fn host() -> Self {
        Vendor::Unknown
    }
}

    /// Return the operating system for the current host.
    pub const fn host() -> Self {
        OperatingSystem::Linux
    }
}

impl Environment {
    /// Return the environment for the current host.
    pub const fn host() -> Self {
        Environment::Gnu
    }
}

impl BinaryFormat {
    /// Return the binary format for the current host.
    pub const fn host() -> Self {
        BinaryFormat::Elf
    }
}

impl Triple {
    /// Return the triple for the current host.
    pub const fn host() -> Self {
        Self {
            architecture: Architecture::X86_64,
            vendor: Vendor::Unknown,
            operating_system: OperatingSystem::Linux,

            binary_format: BinaryFormat::Elf,
